panels.description: Height of the latest finalized block that marshal knows about
panels.title: Marshal Finalized Height

panels.description: Height of the latest finalized block that the application has processed
panels.title: Marshal Processed Height
Handoff Events/s
panels.description: Term-start handoff lifecycle events across validators, by event. RelayedBeforeCertification counts proposals relayed on an uncertified parent. VotedBeforeCertification counts proposals voted on before their parent certified.

panels.title: Handoffs Abandoned/s
panels.description: Handoff requests, candidates, and builds abandoned before the proposer voted, by reason.
Mimalloc's accounting of committed memory, which leaves out the pinned reservation. On Unix, purging returns pages to the OS without lowering this figure, so its gap to RSS is not allocator overhead.
panels.title: Committed Bytes

panels.description: Bytes handed out to callers by mimalloc, as of each thread's last statistics merge (may lag live usage).
panels.title: Allocated Bytes

panels.description: Address space mimalloc has reserved from the OS, including the pinned reservation.
panels.title: Reserved Bytes

panels.description: Mimalloc pages in use, as of each thread's last statistics merge (may lag live usage).
panels.title: Allocator Pages

panels.description: Rate at which mimalloc returns memory to the OS. Sustained purging alongside high RSS indicates churn or fragmentation.
panels.title: Purged Bytes/s

panels.description: Rate of purge operations performed by mimalloc.
panels.title: Purge Calls/s

panels.description: Rate of memory mappings mimalloc requests from the OS. Steady non-zero rates indicate the heap is still growing or being recycled.
panels.title: mmap Calls/s

panels.description: Rate of allocations larger than mimalloc's largest size class; these bypass size-class pages.
panels.title: Huge Allocations/s

panels.description: Reads served without touching a blob across every contiguous journal (the paged cache itself exports no metrics, so per-journal hit/miss counters are the efficacy proxy; segmented journals are invisible here and the hits-less public-key cache is excluded). Sustained dips are the page cache thrashing.

targets.expr: sum(rate((label_replace({__name__=~".+_cache_hits_total", __name__!~".*public_key.*", deployer_name=~"$Validator", deployer_region=~"$Region"}, "journal", "$1", "__name__", "(.+)"))[$__rate_interval:15s])) / (sum(rate((label_replace({__name__=~".+_cache_hits_total", __name__!~".*public_key.*", deployer_name=~"$Validator", deployer_region=~"$Region"}, "journal", "$1", "__name__", "(.+)"))[$__rate_interval:15s])) + sum(rate((label_replace({__name__=~".+_cache_misses_total", __name__!~".*public_key.*", deployer_name=~"$Validator", deployer_region=~"$Region"}, "journal", "$1", "__name__", "(.+)"))[$__rate_interval:15s])))

panels.title: Journal Cache Hit Rate

panels.description: Which journal is generating blob reads. A single dominant series identifies the cache (or journal) worth resizing first.
panels.title: Journal Cache Misses/s

panels.description: Blob reads that escaped every cache and hit the backend (global miss proxy). Compare against Disk Reads per Second: if this is high while journal hit rates look fine, the misses are coming from uninstrumented (segmented) journals.
panels.title: Backend Reads/s
Upload Lag Behind Chain Tip
panels.description: Blocks between the chain's finalized tip and what the indexer has captured into the durable queue (hook) and published to the Store (acknowledged floor).

panels.title: Finalized Hook Stages p95
panels.description: The hook runs on the stateful actor's critical path. Total must stay well under the block cadence.

panels.title: Record Enqueue Breakdown (avg)
panels.description: The gap between record enqueue and journal append plus commit is time spent waiting for the shared queue lock.

panels.title: Store Logical Commit Latency p95
panels.description: Total logical batch latency across all attempts. Includes request encoding and compression plus retry backoff. Records success and failure.

panels.title: Simplex Body Bytes per Store Commit
Observed Memory Amplification
panels.description: Process RSS divided by the encoded payload bytes of admitted uploads. Compare against the configured amplification to retune the admission budget.

panels.title: Finalization to Publication Latency
panels.description: Duration from the recorded finalization timestamp in the durable queue to contiguous QMDB and SQL publication barrier completion. Includes queue waiting and replay. Does not measure Simplex or explorer visibility.

panels.title: Store Put Attempt Latency p95
panels.description: Per-attempt client-observed SDK Put latency. Includes request encoding and compression, transport, response handling, errors, and cancellation. Excludes retry backoff and other attempts.
